title: Design System: IMO Studio · Liquid Desk 3.1

display.purpose: Welcome task heading; native type at an expressive operational scale.

author.purpose: Fixed quiet credit; full opacity, responsive size, never exported.

table-data.purpose: Independent table pixel size; UI scaling must not alter workbook output.

shadows.name: yzrt-edge-light
shadows.purpose: Actual opposing inset edges and dark inner boundary on route, dock, library, welcome, and active selections. Preserved base recipe; the full-liquid major-layer override is recorded separately as prism.

shadows.name: yzrt-depth-light
shadows.purpose: Shared soft lower depth of default light CSS glass layers. Preserved base recipe; the full-liquid major-layer override is recorded separately as prism.

shadows.name: yzrt-edge-dark
shadows.purpose: Pale opposing inset rims with a dark inner boundary in dark mode. Preserved base recipe; the full-liquid major-layer override is recorded separately as prism.

shadows.name: yzrt-depth-dark
shadows.purpose: Shared dark-mode lower depth. Preserved base recipe; the full-liquid major-layer override is recorded separately as prism.

shadows.name: soft-glass-depth
shadows.purpose: The shared softer depth in both themes when glassStyle is soft.

shadows.name: selected-lens-light
shadows.purpose: Compact active port/dock/library depth; combine with the yzrt edge. Full-liquid port/dock selections use the separate prism-selected recipe; library tiles retain this base treatment.

shadows.name: selected-lens-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark compact active-lens depth; combine with the dark yzrt edge. Full-liquid port/dock selections use the separate prism-selected recipe; library tiles retain this base treatment.

shadows.name: inner-sheen-depth
shadows.purpose: Soft shadow under the inset 7px inner-edge pseudo-element.

shadows.name: clear-surface
shadows.purpose: Opaque major surfaces in clear mode and effective reduced transparency.

shadows.name: lens-edge-light
shadows.purpose: Retained base sheet rim on editor, dialogs, and smaller base-family surfaces. Full-liquid editor/dialog use the separate prism edge and source-specific lift.

shadows.name: lens-edge-dark
shadows.purpose: Retained illuminated base sheet rim in dark mode. Full-liquid editor/dialog use the separate prism edge and source-specific lift.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Ordinary convex secondary control.

shadows.name: control-hover
shadows.purpose: Visible secondary-control hover.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Solid accent action with tactile upper/lower depth.

shadows.name: editor-ambient
shadows.purpose: Broad working-sheet lift; combine with the base sheet rim. Full-liquid editor/dialog use the separate prism edge and source-specific lift.

shadows.name: dialog-ambient
shadows.purpose: Protected decision layer over the blurred scrim; combine with the base sheet rim. Full-liquid editor/dialog use the separate prism edge and source-specific lift.

shadows.name: prism-edge-light
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 light opposing inset edge for major liquid/full layers; shared by navigation, library, welcome, editor, and dialogs.

shadows.name: prism-depth-light
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 light lower depth shared by route, dock, library, and welcome only in liquid/full mode.

shadows.name: prism-selected-light
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 light compact selected port/dock depth in liquid/full mode; does not replace selected library-tile material.

shadows.name: prism-action-secondary-light
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 light secondary control depth scoped to footer, document, and dialog action rows in liquid/full mode.

shadows.name: prism-edge-dark
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 dark opposing inset edge for major liquid/full layers; shared by navigation, library, welcome, editor, and dialogs.

shadows.name: prism-depth-dark
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 dark lower depth shared by route, dock, library, and welcome only in liquid/full mode.

shadows.name: prism-selected-dark
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 dark compact selected port/dock depth in liquid/full mode; does not replace selected library-tile material.

shadows.name: prism-action-secondary-dark
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 dark secondary control depth scoped to footer, document, and dialog action rows in liquid/full mode.

shadows.name: prism-action-primary
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 accent-derived primary control depth scoped to footer, document, and dialog action rows in liquid/full mode.

shadows.name: prism-editor-ambient
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 broad editing-sheet lift in liquid/full mode; combine with the prism edge.

shadows.name: prism-dialog-ambient
shadows.purpose: 3.2.1 temporary decision-layer lift in liquid/full mode; combine with the prism edge.

motion.name: control-background
motion.purpose: Background changes on operational controls and switches.

motion.name: glass-press
motion.purpose: Pressed port, dock, and active library lens.

motion.name: library-reveal
motion.purpose: From opacity .85, translateY 10px, blur 3px to fully visible clear material.

motion.name: switch-knob
motion.purpose: Move the 15px knob 13px within the fixed 34×21 switch.

motion.name: ambient-field
motion.purpose: CSS compositor-only transform: scale(1.025) translate3d(-.35%,0,0) to scale(1.025) translate3d(.35%,.45%,0). No frame-by-frame Canvas painting.

motion.name: static-field-schedule
motion.purpose: Coalesce size/theme/background paints and skip identical cached keys. Canvas allocation <=2,000,000 pixels; DPR capped at 1.25.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System reduced motion, user reduced motion, effective reduced transparency, or plain background removes animation, transitions, and smooth scrolling; live flags refresh dynamically.

motion.name: reduced-transparency
motion.purpose: System reduced transparency or clear mode replaces major grounds with the opaque clear surface and removes their backdrop filters and yzrt highlights.

motion.name: hidden-state
motion.purpose: Pause the CSS backdrop animation while hidden; refresh effective preferences without an idle paint loop.

narrative.overview:
Liquid Desk is an open voyage workstation built from convex glass. A compact masthead and detached route capsule sit above a broad editing lens; a floating instrument dock keeps navigation, saving, and generation within reach. The file library appears only when requested. Aqua, periwinkle, and peach water ribbons transmit through opposing inset rims, diagonal highlights, and a soft inner edge. The approved strong-liquid variant adds a double edge and a more transmitting gradient across the navigation, editing, and decision layers.

Version 3.1 refines the committed 3.0 topology in work/liquid-reset-direction.md using the actual yzrt material and simple appearance choices specified in work/yzrt-integration-direction.md. Version 3.2.1 strengthens that material under the explicit follow-up in work/notice-fix-direction.md, without replacing the workstation. The open desk and extreme Liquid Glass identity remain the visual authority. The earlier fixed file outline and minimalism/glass blend are historical anti-reference. The operational hierarchy, Chinese interface, local workflow, ten document templates, and exact workbook output remain product truth.

The visual world is code-led. One local cached Canvas supplies the authored ground; scoped CSS supplies the glass material. The yzrt source, modification attribution, and GPL-2.0 text are preserved in work/reference-yzrt/ and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. There is no approved image comp. The context/concept-seed launcher and one-time detector invocation were blocked by Windows group policy; no seed key, generated concept card, or detector verdict is claimed. The earlier 17 captures in .impeccable/review/yzrt/ and current 3.2.1 captures in .impeccable/review/prism-321/ and .impeccable/review/flow32/ are interface evidence using synthetic demonstration content, not production records or background assets. They do not establish physical optical refraction, actual Office printing, or untested devices.
keyCharacteristics: An open editing canvas with no permanent sidebar.
Detached route and instrument lenses, plus an on-demand file library.
Source-derived CSS rims on navigation, library, and welcome, with the approved strong-liquid treatment on the editor, dialogs, selected lenses, and action controls.
Authored aqua/periwinkle/peach geometry, optional soft glass, and an opaque clear mode.
Native operational typography, independent data type, and mobile, dark, short-height, and system-preference treatments.

rules.name: The Composited Ink Rule
rules.body: Judge small text against the actual illuminated material in both themes. Keep ink and metadata at full opacity; use their dedicated color roles to establish hierarchy.

rules.name: The Two Type Controls Rule
rules.body: Shell type scales from the user-selected root size; table data keeps its independent pixel setting. Interface styling must never alter the workbook's typography or print layout.

rules.name: The Open Desk Rule
rules.body: Reserve the canvas for the current port and document. The file library is an on-demand popover; route context and the detached dock carry navigation without a permanent sidebar.

rules.name: The Backed Data Rule
rules.body: Let glass transmit through the surrounding sheet and controls while table cells retain their dedicated, nearly opaque backing. Optical contrast must not cross dense text.

rules.name: The Local Optics Rule
rules.body: The material combines local authored geometry, source-derived CSS edges, diagonal highlights, depth, and bounded specular feedback. Apply the stronger double-edge and gradient variant only to liquid glass with full effective transparency; preserve the soft/clear recipes, source attribution, and effective system-preference behavior.

rules.name: The Family Resemblance Rule
rules.body: Use the current scale of rounded fields, compact table wrappers, convex selection lenses, and broad sheets. Do not force every layer into one radius or surround every subsection with another glass card.

dos: **Do** keep the masthead, floating route capsule, broad editor, and detached instrument dock legible as separate layers.
**Do** open the file library on demand, preserve its search and keyboard dismissal, and return focus to its invoker.

**Do** preserve the cached local Canvas ribbons, source-derived opposing CSS rims, diagonal highlights, and bounded specular response; limit the stronger double-edge variant to full-transparency liquid glass.
**Do** retain practical table backing, internal scrolling, independent type settings, and the light/dark and preference fallbacks.
**Do** keep explicit empty/NIL/zero states, port-specific defaults, identity-reviewed restore, and per-view scroll memory intact.
**Do** preserve the fixed, quiet author credit at full opacity and exclude it from Excel output.
**Do** keep four common appearance choices visible and four glass/background choices folded; respect live system effects preferences and reset only the nine appearance fields.
donts: **Don't** restore a permanent sidebar, simulated OS window, dashboard of cards, or the discarded 2.1 frame.
**Don't** substitute a wallpaper image, an external resource, or blur alone for the implemented source-derived material, or copy the upstream demo's global contrast and text-selection rules.
**Don't** wash the water ribbons through dense table text or stack decorative glass cards inside the editing sheet.
**Don't** hide save/generate on mobile, leak table overflow onto the page, or trap focus in the nonmodal file library.
**Don't** merge interface and table type controls, silently change port answers, or alter the original workbook print structure.
**Don't** reintroduce retired stylesheets or claim a concept seed, approved comp, or detector result that does not exist.
**Don't** reintroduce SVG displacement maps, an idle Canvas paint loop, or user settings that override the system's reduced motion or reduced transparency preference.
